description: US border crossing wait times — Live U.S. Customs and Border Protection wait times at land ports on the Mexico and Canada borders: per crossing, passenger vehicle lanes (standard, NEXUS/SENTRI, Ready Lane), pedestrian lanes and commercial lanes (standard, FAST) with posted delay minutes, lanes open, update time, port status and hours, plus the fastest and slowest crossing. port= matches port or crossing names (San Ysidro, Laredo, El Paso, Detroit, Blaine, Peace Bridge); or border=mexico|canada for every port; optional mode=passenger|pedestrian|commercial (also sets the ranking), limit= (max 85). Unknown port returns the list of valid port names. Cached 5 minutes. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: travel_border_wait
